c025.title: A parcel for Max
c025.story: Max loves [[online shopping]]. One evening he opens his favorite [[site]]. He finds great headphones in its [[catalog]]. He uses a [[coupon]] and saves ten dollars. Every day he checks the [[status]] of his order. On Friday a [[courier]] brings the box to his door. But the [[product]] does not look right. The left side is very quiet, so it has a [[defect]]. "This is a [[fake]]!" Max tells Anna. He sends it back and gets his money back. Then he buys real headphones from a good seller on a [[marketplace]].

c026.title: Sofia's first fashion show
c026.story: Max's sister Sofia is studying to be a [[fashion designer]]. On Saturday she shows her first collection at a small [[fashion show]] in Kyiv. It isn't real [[couture]], but every piece is made by hand. A tall [[supermodel]] opens the show in a black [[corset]] and a long red [[cape]]. Next come soft jackets in [[cashmere]], [[tweed]] and [[flannel]]. The last model, dressed like a [[dandy]], wears a smart suit in [[khaki]]. After the show, Anna asks Sofia why she never uses nylon or polyester. Sofia smiles. "Natural [[material]] like wool feels better on the skin." "And good [[textiles|textile]] last for years," she adds. Her teacher says it is the best collection in the class.

c027.title: Around Kyiv by metro
c027.story: Anna's cousin Taras is her [[visitor]] today. It is his first [[visit]] to Kyiv. Kyiv has three [[million]] people. Anna loves public [[transport]], so they take the [[metro]]. An [[inspector]] checks their tickets. The [[escalator]] takes them up to the [[center]]. They walk down the [[avenue]] to the [[park]]. Taras takes photos of a big [[monument]]. "Excuse me, [[mister]], your wallet!" a woman calls. Taras says thank you. Then they ask a [[policeman]] the way home.

c028.title: Taxi to the airport
c028.story: Anna flies to London today. Max helps her with her [[stuff]]. They put two bags in a [[taxi]]. The driver turns on the [[GPS]]. He takes the [[highway]] to the airport. It is forty [[kilometers|kilometer]] away. "Thirty minutes [[max]]," he says. Soon they stop at the [[terminal]]. Free [[shuttle]] buses wait next to it. Anna hugs Max and runs inside.

c029.title: Anna's first flight
c029.story: Anna's first flight starts with [[chaos]] at the airport. Her [[baggage]] weighs twenty [[kilograms|kilogram]], just right. She shows her [[passport]] and [[visa]] to the officer. Border [[control]] is quick and easy. At the [[duty-free]] she buys chocolate for her friends. Then she sees a [[celebrity]] going into [[business class]]! On the [[aeroplane]], a friendly [[steward]] brings her coffee. She changes planes at a big [[hub]] in Europe. But her bag gets lost in [[transit]]. Her power [[converter]] is in that bag too! In London she has bad [[jet lag]] and no charger. The next day the bag arrives, and Anna laughs.

c030.title: A hotel for the weekend
c030.story: Max finds a cheap [[hotel]] in Lviv. He makes a [[booking]] for the weekend. The room is for four people [[maximum]]. There is a fee for a [[no-show]]. On Friday, Max and Anna go to [[reception]]. The [[check-in]] is very quick. The woman gives them the [[Wi-Fi]] password. Their room is at the end of the [[corridor]]. It is small, not [[deluxe]], but nice. Max needs a phone [[adapter]], and they have one. [[Check-out|check-out]] is at eleven on Sunday. Max and Anna love their weekend.

c031.title: A night of luxury
c031.story: Anna wins a night in a [[luxury]] hotel in a radio competition. A smiling [[concierge]] meets her in the [[foyer]]. Her room has a [[king-size]] bed and a [[jacuzzi]]. In the evening she tries the [[spa]]. First she gets a back [[massage]], then she relaxes in the [[sauna]]. In the morning she orders breakfast from [[room service]]. She sends Max a photo: "I never want to go home!"

c032.title: Max's new scooter
c032.story: Max buys an electric [[scooter]] to get to college faster. On Monday he rides on the smooth [[asphalt]] by the river. A [[biker]] on a loud motorcycle passes him. Max goes faster and forgets the speed [[limit]]. In a dark [[tunnel]] he almost hits a [[bicycle]]. Luckily, he sees its red [[reflector]] just in time. The cyclist stops, her foot still on the [[pedal]]. "Slow down!" she shouts. After this [[incident]], Max always rides slowly.

c033.title: Dad buys a car
c033.story: Anna's dad is a car [[enthusiast]]. He watches every [[grand prix]] on TV. Now he wants a new [[automobile]] for the family. On Saturday Anna and Dad go to a car [[dealer]]. In the big [[showroom]], Dad stops next to a red [[supercar]]. Then he looks at a long white [[limousine]]. "Too expensive, Dad," Anna laughs. So he chooses between a [[sedan]] and a [[diesel]] [[minivan]]. Anna's driving [[instructor]] comes too and gives good advice. Dad takes the minivan for a [[test drive]]. Then he asks the manager about [[leasing]]. Next week the family drives home in a new car.

c034.title: The car breaks down
c034.story: On the way to the dacha, Dad presses the [[accelerator]]. But the car slows down, and the [[motor]] stops. Anna calls a [[mechanic]] from a small [[auto]] repair shop. He comes quickly and takes the car to his [[garage]]. There he uses a very loud air [[compressor]]. He cleans the [[carburetor]], and the car starts again. He also checks the [[chassis]], and it is fine. Then he finds a crack in the [[bumper]] and fixes it. Dad pays, and the family gets to the dacha for dinner.

c035.title: A road trip in America
c035.story: Max and his cousin Ivan go on a [[road trip]] in America. Uncle Petro drives a [[camper]], and the boys have an old [[jeep]]. It has a [[turbo]], so it is fast. They take an [[off-road]] path into the hills. Max's phone sits in a [[holder]] and shows the map. At a gas station, gas costs four dollars a [[gallon]]. In the evening they follow a [[pickup]] to a cheap [[motel]]. Each boy eats a huge [[cheeseburger]]. Uncle Petro tries a [[bourbon]] and makes a funny face. Everyone sleeps well after a long day.

c036.title: Planning a summer trip
c036.story: Anna and Max want a [[trip]] in August. They go to a travel [[bureau]] in Kyiv. An [[agent]] meets them with a smile. She works for a big [[tour operator]]. She shows them a [[low-cost]] flight. This plane flies [[nonstop]] to the coast. A [[charter]] is cheap too. Or they take a bus [[tour]] with a [[guide]]. "[[Tourism|tourism]] is very big this year," she says. "Every [[tourist]] wants to go to the sea." Max has a [[voucher]] from his mom. They book two bus seats and smile.
